title: UniProt: the Universal Protein Knowledgebase in 2025
funder: National Human Genome Research Institute [HG002273]; NIH Office of the Director [U24HG007822]; NIAID; NIA; NIGMS [R35GM141873]; NIDDK; NEI; NCI; NHLBI; BBSRC [BB/T015608/1]; National Science Foundation Directorate for Biological Sciences [BB/X002179/1]; Open Targets; Horizon 2020 [825575]; Swiss State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation; EMBL Australia.
result: Reviewed UniProtKB entries, release 2026_03, read through rest.uniprot.org. HMGCR (P04035): converts HMG-CoA to mevalonate, the rate-limiting step in the synthesis of cholesterol and other isoprenoids; ER membrane; main target of statins. FDFT1 (P37268): joins two farnesyl diphosphates through presqualene diphosphate with NADPH or NADH; first committed enzyme of sterol synthesis. SQLE (Q14534): oxidises squalene to (S)-2,3-epoxysqualene; considered a rate-limiting enzyme. FDPS (P14324): forms farnesyl diphosphate, precursor of sterols, dolichols and ubiquinones and substrate for protein farnesylation and geranylgeranylation. GGPS1 (O95749): forms geranylgeranyl diphosphate. PDSS1 (Q5T2R2) and PDSS2 (Q86YH6): extend farnesyl diphosphate with isopentenyl diphosphate to the decaprenyl side chain of ubiquinone-10; mitochondrion. COQ2 (Q96H96): prenylates 4-hydroxybenzoate with the polyprenyl chain; in humans the product is CoQ10, which transports electrons between respiratory chain complexes. DHDDS (Q86SQ9) and NUS1 (Q96E22): condense isopentenyl diphosphate onto farnesyl diphosphate to dehydrodolichyl diphosphate, mostly C95 and C100, precursor of dolichol phosphate, the sugar carrier for ER protein glycosylation. SRD5A3 (Q9H8P0): polyprenal reductase in the conversion of polyprenol to dolichol. FNTA (P49354), FNTB (P49356) and PGGT1B (P53609): transfer a farnesyl or geranylgeranyl group to the cysteine fourth from the C-terminus of proteins ending in Cys-aliphatic-aliphatic-X. LDLR (P01130): binds LDL, the major cholesterol-carrying lipoprotein of plasma, and transports it into cells by endocytosis; receptor-ligand complexes first cluster into clathrin-coated pits. PCSK9 (Q8NBP7): binds LDLR and promotes its degradation in intracellular acidic compartments by a non-proteolytic mechanism. NPC1L1 (Q9UHC9): critical for cholesterol uptake across the enterocyte plasma membrane; apical membrane. CYP7A1 (P22680): 7-alpha-hydroxylates cholesterol, a rate-limiting step of bile acid synthesis, with electrons from NADPH through cytochrome P450 reductase; ER membrane. FGF19 (O95750): suppresses bile acid synthesis by down-regulating CYP7A1; activity requires KLB and FGFR4.
